entries.4488e78dc13cc8de: This business is conducted by the consolidated subsidiary Kabuki-za Service Co., Ltd., which operates restaurants and food outlets mainly inside the theater and in the underground plaza (Kobikicho Plaza). Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥791 million.
entries.6584ff62fb1cdf36: This business is conducted by the consolidated subsidiary Kabuki-za Service Co., Ltd., which operates kiosks selling Kabuki-related goods and souvenirs mainly inside the theater and in the underground plaza (Kobikicho Plaza). Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥815 million.
entries.ca6ae484675e0f90: A company that owns and leases the land and building of the "Kabuki-za" theater in Ginza, Tokyo, and also operates the restaurants and shops inside the theater.
entries.cf992960a303b030: This business owns land and buildings through the company and its consolidated subsidiary Kabuki-za Service Co., Ltd., and leases them out. The theater Kabuki-za is leased to Shochiku Co., Ltd., and the theater site is partly borrowed from Shochiku Co., Ltd. and others, and partly leased to Shochiku Co., Ltd. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥2,026 million.
